title: Unauthorised transactions
body:
I have calculated up to 320 USD of unauthorised transactions since downloading the app under a 7 day free trial period on the 17 of August. 
The deception of an app claimed to have been designed to help people form routines they can follow taking advantage of that same lack of structure is appalling! Currently pursuing action against this embezzlement now, and will not stop until I get a full refund. Masquerading as a tool of construction whilst performing gross manipulation is not something that can go unpunished for too long. To take people’s payment details as a prerequisite for downloading the app, and then using them without their consent, abysmal!

Dear Fabulous Team,

First of all, I received a 30-day Premium Guest Pass from a dear friend. She shared a link with me, clicked the link and I signed up using my email to redeem the pass. My friend reminded me to cancel the free trial after installing the app, which I did cancel the free trial AND premium subscription right after I installed it. Once installed it, I continued using it by signing in using the SAME email from the link my friend shared with. But the problem was that I could not use premium features unless I subscribed to it.

On June 15, Fabulous app making attempts to charge my card $39.99 even today, June 19, this app is still making attempts to charge my card.

I seek your assistance on this issue and kindly fix it ASAP as I already cancelled the premium subscription.

Thank you!
